prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Pasadena, Texas, and has concussion. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1306; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the sideswipe collision you reported in Pasadena, Texas. Is it all right if I record this conversation?

A: Yes, that's fine.

Q: Please state your full name and the best number to reach you.

A: I'd rather keep my personal details off the recording for now, but you have my claim file information.

Q: That's understood. Can you walk me through what happened before the impact?

A: I was in the right lane on a multi-lane road, heading toward a turn. I checked my mirror, signaled, and started moving left to get into the middle lane. I didn't see the other car in my blind spot until it was already alongside me.

Q: Did you feel any contact between the vehicles?

A: Yes, there was a scrape and a jolt, and my car pulled toward the right. I pulled onto the shoulder once I could control it.

Q: Did you hit your head or lose consciousness at any point?

A: I hit the side window with my head. I don't think I blacked out completely, but I was dazed and my neck was sore.

Q: Have you been evaluated by a medical professional since the collision?

A: Yes, I went to an urgent care clinic that afternoon. They said I have a concussion and told me to limit screen time and rest.

Q: Are you still experiencing symptoms?

A: Yes, I get headaches in the evening, and bright lights bother me. I'm trying to keep up with my follow-up appointments.

Q: Thank you. I'll follow up with the medical records and the police report. Is there anything else you'd like to add?

A: Only that I want the other driver's information documented accurately.

Q: Understood. Thank you for your cooperation today.
